mechanism: Independent conditional low-rank adaptation of a frozen source-response neural operator, inspired by BOLERO conditional weight generation. No DNA sequence, ATAC, pretrained BOLERO weights or chromVAR activity is used; not a BOLERO reproduction.
novelty: V14 fitted per-output linear context slopes; V30 STRING-to-source-basis regressions; V35/V36 learned attention/gene decoders; V84 a linear essential-target response operator. Here an MLP generates both low-rank factors for each frozen backbone layer from continuous source and query control-rank features. Actual measured response vectors, not target identity alone, are operator inputs.
sources: Existing validated K562,CD4,H1,HCT116,HEK293T panel responses with bounded90%-dose convention. Whole H1, Orion(both lines), or CD4(all states/donors) excluded before basis, backbone, conditional adapter and null fits.
outputs: Complete-case nonpanel output axis: source NTC CPM finite and>5 and measured in every present source target. Require>=512genes; do not fill absent response values. Present target requires>=100measured outputs. Missing target/source rows omitted. Complete-case masks use all permitted source rows; quantitative fitting uses only240 training targets.
basis: 32-component randomized SVD on source fitting-target assay responses log1p(.05CPM*2^LFC)-log1p(.05CPM). Latent RMS scale floor0.1. Deterministic16dim random sketch of centered unit source/query measured expression ranks. Missing query embedding features are centered zero only, >=90%measured query required; no RNA pseudocount. Panel genes excluded from context axes and bases.
model: Frozen-backbone pretraining: residual32->64 GELU->32 MLP, zero-initialized final layer. For each layer add0.1*B(c)A(c), rank4. Each factor generated by48->32 GELU->factor MLP, B final layer zero-initialized. Condition concatenates source16,query16,difference16. No condition-dependent base bias. Every base parameter frozen during adapter fitting and checked exactly.
fit: Directed source pairs only between distinct study groups, same measured target. Pair weights inverse target-count and number of source/destination lines per study. 240/60 deterministic global target split(seed87087); source validation targets excluded from SVD and fitted labels. All100epochs of fullbatch AdamW lr.001 weightdecay.001 gradientclip1, best epoch0..100 chosen by source-target validation normalized coefficient MSE. This is bounded training, not convergence evidence.
controls: constant25: same frozen real backbone and adapter architecture, all conditioner inputs zero, independently optimized. conditional25_shuffled: source target labels independently cyclically shifted by37+11*sourceindex BEFORE basis/backbone/adapter fitting and inference, fully refitted. Same hyperparameters and seeds. All outputs retained, no alternative strength selection.
inference: Pool mapped source latent predictions with exp(2cosine rank-sketch similarity) weights and inverse source-lines/study count; decode fixed basis. Only supported finite positive query outputs proposed. 25% of LFC difference bounded+/-0.5, followed by unchanged80%V66 identity-margin guard. Own LFC always0, emitter handles explicit knockdown. Pre-guard panel effects unchanged; guard/profile closure may change other effect factors.
development: All655 reused public target-context pairs, same truth bank and V66 comparator as V86. Equal study H1/Orion/CD4. Require profile ratio<=.995,worststudy<=1.03,PDSchange>=-.005, beats constant and fully refitted shuffled profile errors. No query-label selection of epochs, architecture or strength.
downstream: Only a passing primary proceeds to unchanged V16 residual10 D3 counts against V66 and both controls, original14targetcohort/seed0; gate as V86, then seed620000 if all pass. D3 is reused, not blind. No cell generation/package otherwise; no automatic upload.
limitations: Only three or four independent training study contexts per outer fold; context is confounded with assay and cannot prove causal response specificity. Actual source response at a target is legitimate evidence; this does not test a never-observed target scenario. Complete-case and low-rank truncation restrict output coverage. Existing V66 mistakes can survive guard.
